Legal Information

Refund Policy Last Updated

Effective Date

May 26, 2026

1. Eligibility For Refunds

Refund requests are reviewed individually depending on service type, infrastructure provisioning status, resource usage, and operational conditions. Customers must contact Sterrocloud through official support channels to initiate refund evaluations within applicable service periods.

2. Non-Refundable Services

Services involving completed infrastructure deployments, dedicated resource allocations, custom configurations, virtual servers, domain registrations, abuse-related suspensions, or excessive resource usage may become non-refundable after provisioning has been completed.

3. Chargebacks & Disputes

Fraudulent chargebacks, unauthorized disputes, payment reversals, or abusive refund claims may result in immediate account suspension, infrastructure termination, and permanent service restrictions across Sterrocloud platforms and associated systems.

4. Cancellation Policy

Customers may request cancellation of active services through billing or support platforms. Service cancellations do not automatically guarantee refunds for completed billing cycles, partially used infrastructure allocations, or prepaid subscription periods.

5. Service Suspension

Services suspended due to unpaid invoices, policy violations, abuse complaints, malicious activity, prohibited workloads, or infrastructure misuse are not eligible for guaranteed refunds and may require administrative review before restoration.

6. Infrastructure Provisioning

Once virtual resources, server instances, infrastructure allocations, networking configurations, or automated deployments are provisioned, associated operational costs may render services partially or fully non-refundable.

7. Abuse & Fraud Protection

Sterrocloud actively monitors transactions and infrastructure usage for fraudulent activity, abuse patterns, policy violations, payment manipulation, and unauthorized access attempts. Refund requests associated with suspicious behavior may be declined without prior notice.

8. Contact Information

For refund requests, billing disputes, cancellation inquiries, or payment assistance, customers may contact Sterrocloud through official communication channels listed on the Contact page or billing platform.
